correctness.rationale:
The published geometric input is the exact formula \(\chi_{\mathrm{top}}(K_m(A))=m^3\sigma(m)\). Multiplicativity of \(\sigma\) reduces the two-adic valuation to prime powers. The factor \(\sigma(2^a)\) is odd; for odd \(p\), \(\sigma(p^e)\) is odd when \(e\) is even, while for odd \(e\) the two-adic lifting-the-exponent identity gives \(
u_2(\sigma(p^e))=
u_2(p+1)+
u_2(e+1)-1\). Summation yields the claimed exact valuation. Vanishing of every summand is equivalent to zero two-adic exponent and even exponents at every odd prime, hence to \(m\) being an odd square. The bundled checker independently verifies the formula through \(m=100000\) but is not used as the infinite proof.

value.rationale: Generalized Kummer varieties form a fundamental deformation family of irreducible holomorphic symplectic manifolds, and their topological Euler characteristic is a basic global invariant. The theorem gives the complete dyadic content of this invariant directly from the Hilbert-scheme length, not merely parity. Its oddness corollary is a natural sharp classification: positive-dimensional odd Euler characteristic occurs on the sparse but infinite odd-square length subsequence, beginning at complex dimension sixteen. This is a structural arithmetic stratification of a canonical geometric family rather than an arbitrary finite congruence slice.
